# Proyecto

> Documento vivo. Rellenar las secciones marcadas con `TODO` en cuanto se definan.

## Visión

Evaluar modelos de IA servidos por NVIDIA (API remota `integrate.api.nvidia.com`) frente a los mismos modelos ejecutados en local con Ollama (Apple Silicon), para decidir con datos cuándo compensa cada opción.

## Objetivos

- Identificar qué modelos del catálogo NVIDIA pueden ejecutarse en local (Ollama, 24 GB de memoria unificada).
- Benchmark reproducible remoto vs local: latencia, tiempo al primer token, tokens/s y calidad de respuesta sobre los mismos prompts.
- Informe comparativo con recomendación por caso de uso.

**Dentro:**
- Modelos de chat/texto presentes en ambos lados (NVIDIA API y Ollama).
- Harness de benchmark en Python, resultados en local.

   120	    backoff waits), so retries are visible in the results instead of hidden.

item.text:
The benchmark uses **client-observed streaming timings**, including network latency, for both NVIDIA and Ollama.

- **TTFT:** `stream_chat()` starts `time.perf_counter()` immediately before the HTTP request. It sets `ttft_s` when the first nonempty content or reasoning delta arrives, and separately records `ttft_content_s` and `ttft_reasoning_s`. `_delta_text()` extracts these fields from provider responses. See [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:97](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:97) and [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:133](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:133).

- **Decode tokens/s:** The `ChatResult.decode_tps` property calculates `completion_tokens / (last_token_s - ttft_s)`, using the provider’s reported token count and the timestamps of the first and last content/reasoning deltas. It returns `None` if required measurements are missing, fewer than **32 tokens** were generated, or generation lasted under **0.25 seconds**. This is approximate because streaming chunks can contain multiple tokens. See [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:74](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:74).

- **End-to-end tokens/s:** `ChatResult.e2e_tps` calculates `completion_tokens / total_s`, including TTFT and stream completion overhead. See [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:90](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:90).

`run()` invokes measurements, `_record()` stores them, and `summarize()` uses `_median()` to report successful non-warmup TTFT measurements; throughput medians use only the designated throughput prompt. `_with_retries()` tracks retries/backoff separately as `observed_s`. See [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:111](src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:111) and [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:238](src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:238).
